title: Register the raw-read hint for the PowerShell tool and recognise PowerShell reads
goal: The PreToolUse raw-read hint entry in .claude/settings.json matches Bash|PowerShell; kb_hook.is_raw_read recognises Get-Content, gc, cat, type and Select-String on a kb article; test_kb.py covers the PowerShell reads and the Bash|PowerShell matcher (replacing test_raw_read_nudge_hook_is_registered_on_bash_only); kb/_self/tools.md describes the hint for both tools.

run: import json,sys; h=json.load(open('.claude/settings.json',encoding='utf-8'))['hooks']['PreToolUse']; sys.exit(0 if any('PowerShell' in e.get('matcher','') and any('kb_hook.py' in x.get('command','') for x in e['hooks']) for e in h) else 1)
